title: Vercel closing call to action
description: A tall, nearly empty closing band: one centred 56px tight heading and two pill buttons, an ink one and a white ringed one that shows three small round icons, a label and a copy icon. Clicking the white one copies a command and its label fades to a confirmation for a moment. Phones stack the heading on two lines and the buttons under each other.
notes: needs JavaScript for the copy button (clipboard + label swap); without it the button is inert
the label fade is CSS and off with reduced motion
